prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Project Delve four-view character reference sheet.
Input Image 1: approved full-body master, PRIMARY and authoritative identity/design reference, not an edit target. Generate a separate derived image; never change or replace the master.
Premium fantasy tabletop board game artwork. Hand-painted digital illustration with rich but controlled colors, detailed textures, subtle brushwork, and a cohesive classic fantasy aesthetic. Clean, readable premium board-game presentation. Soft directional lighting from the upper left and a simple subdued neutral gray background. Preserve the approved reference material colors and painting; no style redesign.
Create ONE new landscape character reference sheet with exactly FOUR clearly separated complete full-body views in one horizontal row: front, side, rear, and front three-quarter, in that order. Same character in every view, neutral resting pose, identical anatomy/proportions/colors/materials/equipment, consistent scale and ground line, generous space between figures and margins around all extremities. Use near-orthographic views with minimal perspective distortion. Preserve the master pose as far as each orientation permits. Infer unseen rear construction only in the simplest consistent way, continuing existing forms and colors; no elaborate new features. Include complete antlers, ears, hands, feet, tails, staff and integrated ground-contact form as applicable. The sheet is supporting reference and must not override the approved full body. No portrait panels or decorative layout.
Subject: The SAME featherless predatory dinosaur: long narrow rounded snout and closed mouth, golden eyes, slate/moss-green scaled hide, ochre irregular stripes from head through torso and tail, pale cream-gray throat and belly, two compact three-fingered forelimbs, two planted clawed hind feet with raised sickle claws, one long gently curved balancing tail. Preserve the exact head anatomy, limb construction and distinctive markings; no feathers, horns, new spikes or equipment.
Preserve identity, face, anatomy, proportions, palette, clothing, materials, accessories and equipment exactly as visible in Image 1. Do not substitute the earlier text concept for the approved image. No added equipment, limbs, horns, ornaments or magical effects. No text, labels, measurements, letters, borders, token frames, faction rings, health markers, UI, logos or watermarks. No scenery, pedestal, miniature base, additional character designs, motion blur, detached effects, bloom or transparency-dependent anatomy.
approval: Agent visually inspected; user review of derived output pending; no Tripo or print validation
visualReview: Four full views preserve green/ochre markings, head shape, two forelimbs, two hind legs, sickle claws and one tail. Side and three-quarter retain complete tail; rear tail is foreshortened. Rear stripe continuation inferred; fine stripe/claw details vary slightly.
